description: This source file defines constants and functions for parsing command-line arguments related to test planning and execution, including options for test filters, configuration, and environment settings.

methods.name: parsePassthroughArgs
methods.description: Parses an array of command-line arguments into file filters and option arguments based on predefined options that require values.

methods.name: countExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Counts the number of explicit file filters provided in command-line arguments.

methods.name: getExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Extracts the list of explicit file filters from command-line arguments.
